title: Climate change probabilities of necessity and sufficiency
content: Figure 8.4 models Climate Response as listening to Greenhouse Gases, Natural Forcing, and Internal Variability. The source assumes exogeneity and no protection and reports PN=0.9 and PS=0.0072 from Hannart's external climate simulations.

variables.name: Greenhouse Gases
variables.content: The top-level binary exposure contrasting current and preindustrial greenhouse-gas levels.

variables.name: Natural Forcing
variables.content: Natural forcing that contributes to climate response.

variables.name: Internal Variability
variables.content: Internal climate variability that contributes to climate response.

variables.name: Climate Response
variables.content: The binary severe-heat-wave response event used for PN and PS.
